caption: The video captures a transparent rectangular cube resting on a pale flat table against a plain wall, with a bright light glowing from within it. The cube casts three colored patches onto the table—a blue patch to the left, an orange patch to the right, and a green patch extending toward the viewer. Faint blue and orange glows also fall on the wall behind. Throughout, the cube holds its position, the diagonal shading line on its top face keeping a constant orientation, and the internal illuminated region remaining a rounded, lens-like core. The projected blue, orange, and green patches persist in place, their edges and brightness wavering slightly over time without any rotation or reorientation of the cube. A small vertical shift of the wall–table horizon suggests minor camera movement rather than object motion, and the scene continues unchanged to the end.
